senses.gloss:
अफल अ-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, unfruitful,
barren; vain, unproductive; deprived of virility; (अस्),
m., N, of a plant, Tamarix Indica; (आ), f. the Aloe
plant, Aloes Perfoliata; another plant, Flacourtia Cata-
phracta.
—अ-फल-काङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, disinterested,
not looking to beneficial consequences.
—अफल-ता,
f. or अफल-त्व, अम्, n. barreness, unprofitableness.
—अ-फल-प्रेप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, one who desires no
recompense.

अफल्गु अ-फल्गु, उस्, उस्, उ, not vain, pro-
dictive, profitable.
आ-फलक, a fence made of planks, palisade.
